CVE-2026-133462 [MCP]: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.49 before 0.11.0, the MCPToolBlock auto-lookup allows a shared agent's author to use the MCP credentials of the user who runs it. Anyone who ran a shared agent containing an MCPToolBlock node, and had already connected the MCP server URL that the node names, had that connection used for any read, write, or delete the server exposes, with the result sent to a host chosen by the author. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

CVE-2026-136620 [MCP]: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.

CVE-2026-136630 [MCP]: Electerm before 5.9.0 contains an origin validation vulnerability in the MCP Server widget that allows remote attackers to execute commands by bypassing Host and Origin checks through DNS rebinding. Attackers can lure users to a page that rebinds to 127.0.0.1 and calls unauthenticated MCP tools on port 30837 to run OS commands locally and on open SSH sessions.

CVE-2026-132260 [Claude Code]: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Any user with a positive credit balance can keep sandboxes running for up to 24 hours on a Pro plan for a flat 1 credit, and each run adds another sandbox. This i…

CVE-2026-130178 [MCP]: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, an incomplete IPv6 blocklist in AutoGPT's outbound SSRF protection allows authenticated users to reach local or private network services. Specifically, _is_ip_blocked and BLOCKED_IP_NETWORKS in autogpt_platform/backend/backend/util/request.py fail to reject the IPv6 unspecified address :: (which connects to ::1 on Linux) as well as 6to4, NAT64, Teredo, and deprecated IPv4-compatible IPv6 encodings. An attacker can pa…

CVE-2026-135747 [MCP]: Apache IoTDB MCP Server logs the IoTDB connection password in plaintext during startup, allowing anyone with access to the logs to obtain the credential. This issue affects Apache IoTDB MCP Server: through 0.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.3.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-136133 [MCP]: NocoDB before 2026.10.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in passwordForgot() that allows unauthenticated attackers to revoke a user's sessions by requesting a password reset. Attackers who know a user's email can repeatedly request resets to sign out users, including super-admins, and permanently destroy their OAuth and MCP application authorizations.

CVE-2026-135614 [MCP]: Improper removal of sensitive information in the troubleshooting tool in the Amazon ECS MCP Server (awslabs.ecs-mcp-server) before 0.1.36 might allow a remote actor who can influence the agent's input to obtain cleartext container environment variable values and secret references from ECS task definitions, which the server's sensitive data setting is intended to redact, via prompt injection that causes the agent to request troubleshooting guidance. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 0.1.36 or later and rotate any credentials stored as plaintext tas…

CVE-2026-136441 [MCP]: Bytebase DBHub MCP Incorrect Authorization Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Bytebase DBHub. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the MCP server. The issue results from an incorrect authorization decision when parsing untrusted SQL. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-27635.

CVE-2026-133449 [MCP]: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.1 through 0.10.0, credentials are sent to a third party when a redirect's Location header hides the new host behind a backslash. A signed-in user who connects an MCP server URL, or runs a shared or marketplace workflow with a host-scoped credential, can have that credential delivered to a third party if the host responds with a redirect whose Location the other party influenced. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

CVE-2026-136535 [MCP]: LiteLLM MCP Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of MCP stdio configurations. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-31815.

CVE-2026-133448 [Claude Code]: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, chat and prompt text passed to the Claude Code CLI is pre-processed before reaching the model, bypassing AutoPilot's tool allow-list and PreToolUse hooks. In both AutoPilot's Claude Agent SDK path and the graph orchestrator block's extended_thinking SDK mode, messages starting with / execute CLI commands or bundled skills, while @<path> mentions read files or list directories on the host and attach the result…

Ash.Page.Keyset.filter/4 in lib/ash/page/keyset.ex decodes the client-supplied page[:after] or page[:before] cursor from Erlang external term format and rejects decoded expressions with Ash.Expr.expr?/1. CVE-2026-130411 [Cursor]: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in woylie flop allows a remote attacker to execute code on the server via a crafted pagination cursor.
